newsitem.title: USA: BOXING-ROMERO RETAINS IBF JUNIOR BANTAMWEIGHT TITLE.
newsitem.headline: BOXING-ROMERO RETAINS IBF JUNIOR BANTAMWEIGHT TITLE.

text.p: Danny Romero successfully defended his International Boxing Federation junior bantamweight title when he stopped fellow American Polo Saucedo in the 12th round on Friday.

In the opening seconds of the round, Romero (28-1) landed a straight right that sent Saucedo (12-3) to the canvas. He followed up with a barrage of punches and referee Robert Byrd waved the fight over with 1:59 to go in the round.
